name: How do I choose the right contractor for an accessibility remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for an accessibility remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for accessibility remodeling, look for experience in accessible design and construction. Verify licenses and insurance, and check references or reviews from previous clients. A good contractor will understand ADA guidelines, local building codes, and prioritize your specific functional needs and comfort. Clear communication and a detailed proposal are also key indicators.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in accessible design, proper licensing, good references, and a clear understanding of your needs and local codes.
